title: Catching up
goal: Catch up with a friend you haven't seen in a while: ask what's new, tell them what you've been doing, ask 'have you ever…?', and say how long ago, since when and for how long.
intro:
*Long time no see! What's new? You've grown a beard! When did that happen?* Catching up is where you need the past tenses most — and Odia has three of them in daily use: **-ଇଲି** (I did), **-ଇଛି** (I've done) and **-ଇଥିଲି** (I did, back then / I had done), plus **-ଉଥିଲି** for what you *were doing* when something happened.

This unit sorts out which is which, and teaches the little words that pin events in time: **ତଳେ** 'ago', **-ରୁ / ପରଠୁ** 'since', and **ହେଲା / ଧରି** 'for (so long)'.

vocab.note: ୱିକେଣ୍ଡ୍ କେମିତି ବିତିଲା? "how was your weekend?" (lit. how did it pass?)
ବୋର୍ ହେବା "to get bored"; ବୋର୍ କରିବା "to bore (someone)".

ଅନୁଭବ କରିବା "to feel, experience".
Very common for weekend trips: ଦାରିଙ୍ଗବାଡ଼ି ଟ୍ରିପ୍. The native word is ଯାତ୍ରା.

With the perfect: ଏବେ ଏବେ ଫେରିଛି "I've just got back".
Usually with ଯିବା: ତୁମେ ବଦଳିଯାଇଛ "you've changed". To change something is ବଦଳାଇବା.

ଫେଲ୍ ହେବା "to fail".
ବିବାହ is the formal word; in speech people say ବାହାଘର.

grammar.title: Did, have done, did back then: -ଇଲି, -ଇଛି, -ଇଥିଲି
grammar.body:
When you catch up, three past forms do most of the work.

**-ଇଛି — present perfect** ('have done'): the result matters *now*, or it happened recently and you don't give a time. It's the tense of **news**: ମୁଁ ନୂଆ ଚାକିରି ଜ୍ୱାଇନ୍ କରିଛି 'I've joined a new job'; ସେ ପାସ୍ କରିଛି 'she's passed'; ତୁମେ ବଦଳିଯାଇଛ 'you've changed'. Endings: ମୁଁ / ସେ -ଇଛି · ଆମେ -ଇଛୁ · ତୁମେ -ଇଛ · ଆପଣ / ସେମାନେ -ଇଛନ୍ତି.

**-ଇଲି — simple past** ('did'): a finished event, usually with a time word or as part of a story: ଗତ ଶନିବାର ସିନେମା ଦେଖିଲି 'I saw a film last Saturday'. As soon as someone asks **କେବେ?** 'when?', the answer switches to -ଇଲି: ଗତ ମାସରେ ଜ୍ୱାଇନ୍ କଲି.

**-ଇଥିଲି — remote past / past perfect** ('did back then', 'had done'): for things further back, or before another past moment: ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ତଳେ ଚିଲିକା ଯାଇଥିଲି 'I went to Chilika two years ago'; ଶେଷ ଥର କେବେ ଦେଖା ହୋଇଥିଲା? 'when did we last meet?'

**Have you ever…?** — **କେବେ** + -ଇଛ **କି?**: ତୁମେ କେବେ ପଖାଳ ଖାଇଛ କି? Answers: ହଁ, ଥରେ ଖାଇଛି 'yes, once' / ଅନେକ ଥର 'lots of times' / ନା, **କେବେ ବି** ଖାଇନି 'never'.

**Negative**: 'haven't' is the -ଇ form + ନାହିଁ, shortened in speech to **-ଇନି**: ଦେଖିନି, ଯାଇନି, ଖାଇନି. In everyday talk this also covers 'didn't': କାଲି ଅଫିସ୍ ଯାଇନି 'I didn't go to the office yesterday'. With **ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ** it means 'not yet' (unit 22).

**Trap**: just as in English, a finished time ('last year', 'two years ago') doesn't go with the perfect: ~~ଗତ ବର୍ଷ ଯାଇଛି~~ → ଗତ ବର୍ଷ **ଗଲି** / **ଯାଇଥିଲି**.

grammar.title: Was doing when…: -ଉଥିଲି in stories
grammar.body:
**-ଉଥିଲି** 'was doing' sets the scene, and a simple past **-ଇଲି** is the event that breaks in:
ମୁଁ ଗାଧୋଉଥିଲି, ସେତେବେଳେ ତୁମ ଫୋନ ଆସିଲା 'I was in the shower when your call came'.
ଯେତେବେଳେ ତୁମେ ଫୋନ କଲ, ମୁଁ ଗାଧୋଉଥିଲି 'when you called, I was in the shower'.

Forms: ମୁଁ କରୁଥିଲି · ଆମେ କରୁଥିଲୁ · ତୁମେ କରୁଥିଲ · ଆପଣ / ସେମାନେ କରୁଥିଲେ · ସେ କରୁଥିଲା.

It is the tense of **excuses**: ମୁଁ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଉଥିଲି 'I was driving', ମିଟିଂରେ ଥିଲି 'I was in a meeting'.

**States use -ଇଥିଲି**: for being *asleep*, *sitting*, *wearing*, *standing*, Odia describes the state you were in, with -ଇଥିଲି: ମୁଁ **ଶୋଇଥିଲି** 'I was asleep', ସେ ବସିଥିଲା 'he was sitting', ନାଲି ଶାଢ଼ୀ ପିନ୍ଧିଥିଲେ 'she was wearing a red saree'. (ଶୋଉଥିଲି would mean 'I was going to bed' or 'I used to sleep'.)

Remember from unit 26 that -ଉଥିଲି can also mean **used to**. A time word decides: ପିଲାଦିନେ ହଷ୍ଟେଲରେ ରହୁଥିଲି 'as a kid I used to live in a hostel' vs. ସେତେବେଳେ ମୁଁ ପଢ଼ୁଥିଲି 'I was studying at that moment'.

**Trap**: one completed event is never -ଉଥିଲି: 'I went to the mall yesterday' is ଗତକାଲି ମଲ୍ **ଗଲି**; ଯାଉଥିଲି would mean 'I was on my way to the mall (when…)'.

grammar.title: Ago, since and for: ତଳେ, -ରୁ, ହେଲା, ଧରି
grammar.body:
**Ago** — time + **ତଳେ** (lit. 'below, back'): ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ତଳେ 'two years ago', କିଛି ଦିନ ତଳେ 'a few days ago', ଅଧ ଘଣ୍ଟା ତଳେ 'half an hour ago'. You'll also hear ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ଆଗରୁ.

**Since** — the starting point + **-ରୁ** / **-ଠାରୁ** ('from'): ଗତ ମାସରୁ 'since last month', ଗତ ବର୍ଷଠାରୁ 'since last year', ପିଲାଦିନରୁ 'since childhood', **ସେତେବେଳୁ** 'since then'. After an event, use **ପରଠୁ**: ବାହାଘର ପରଠୁ 'since the wedding', ଜ୍ୱାଇନ୍ କରିବା ପରଠୁ 'since joining'. Ask with **କେବେଠୁ?** 'since when?'.

**For (and still going)** — time + **ହେଲା** ('it has become') with the **present** continuous: ମୁଁ ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ହେଲା ଏଠି ରହୁଛି 'I've been living here for two years'. Odia uses the present because it's still going on — no perfect tense as in English. Ask with **କେତେ ଦିନ ହେଲା …?** 'how long have you been…?'.

**For (a stretch)** — time + **ଧରି** ('holding'), for something still going on or finished: ଅଧ ଘଣ୍ଟା ଧରି ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରୁଛି 'I've been waiting for half an hour'; ସେ ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ଧରି ପୁଣେରେ ଥିଲା 'she was in Pune for two years'.

**It's been ages**: ବହୁତ ଦିନ ହେଲା ଦେଖା ହୋଇନି 'we haven't seen each other for ages'.

**Trap**: ତଳେ and ହେଲା look similar but mean opposite things — ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ **ତଳେ** ଆସିଲି 'I came two years ago', ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ **ହେଲା** ଏଠି ଅଛି 'I've been here for two years'.

dialogue.title: Running into Sweta
dialogue.setting: Sam bumps into Sweta, an old classmate, at Esplanade mall in Bhubaneswar.

lines.speaker: Sweta
lines.native: ଆରେ ସାମ୍! ବହୁତ ଦିନ ପରେ ଦେଖା!
lines.roman: are Sam! bôhutô dinô pôre dekha!
lines.en: Hey, Sam! Long time no see!

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.native: ଶ୍ୱେତା! ଶେଷ ଥର କେବେ ଦେଖା ହୋଇଥିଲା — ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ତଳେ?
lines.roman: Sweta! sesô thôrô kebe dekha hoithila — dui bôrsô tôḷe?
lines.en: Sweta! When did we last see each other — two years ago?

lines.speaker: Sweta
lines.native: ହଁ, ରାଜୁର ବାହାଘରରେ। ଆଉ, କ'ଣ ଖବର? ତୁମେ ଦାଢ଼ି ରଖିଛ!
lines.roman: hôṃ, Rajurô bahaghôrôre. au, kôṇô khôbôrô? tume daṛhi rôkhichhô!
lines.en: Yes, at Raju's wedding. So, what's new? You've grown a beard!

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.native: ହଁ, ଆଉ ମୁଁ ଗତ ମାସରେ ନୂଆ ଚାକିରି ଜ୍ୱାଇନ୍ କଲି — ଇନଫୋସିଟିରେ।
lines.roman: hôṃ, au muṃ gôtô masôre nua chakiri jwain kôli — Inphosiṭire.
lines.en: Yeah, and I joined a new job last month — in Infocity.

lines.speaker: Sweta
lines.native: ବାଃ! ଆଉ ସେଇ ଗର୍ଲଫ୍ରେଣ୍ଡ୍… ଯାହା ସହିତ ତୁମେ ସବୁବେଳେ ଫୋନରେ କଥା ହେଉଥିଲ?
lines.roman: baḥ! au sei gôrlphreṇḍ… jaha sôhitô tume sôbubeḷe phonôre kôtha heuthilô?
lines.en: Wow! And that girlfriend… the one you were always on the phone to?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.native: ସେ କଥା ଛାଡ଼… ଏକ ବର୍ଷ ହେଲା ବ୍ରେକଅପ୍ ହୋଇଗଲାଣି। ତୁମ କଥା କୁହ!
lines.roman: se kôtha chhaṛô… ekô bôrsô hela brekôp hoigôlaṇi. tumô kôtha kuhô!
lines.en: Forget that… we broke up a year ago now. Tell me about you!

lines.speaker: Sweta
lines.native: ମୁଁ ଏବେ ଏବେ ପୁଣେରୁ ଫେରିଛି। ସେଠି ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ଧରି ମାଷ୍ଟର୍ସ କରୁଥିଲି।

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.native: ପକ୍କା! କିନ୍ତୁ ଏଥର ଯୋଗାଯୋଗରେ ରହିବା — ଆଉ ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ନୁହେଁ!
lines.roman: pôkka! kintu ethôrô jogajogôre rôhiba — au dui bôrsô nuheṃ!
lines.en: Definitely! But this time let's stay in touch — not another two years!

culture: Catching up in Odisha starts with food: **ଖାଇଲଣି?** 'have you eaten yet?' is as much a greeting as a question. Older relatives and neighbours will move quickly to job, salary, marriage (ବାହାଘର କେବେ?) and weight (ତୁମେ ପତଳା ହୋଇଗଲଣି / ମୋଟା ହୋଇଗଲଣି) — it's normal small talk, not prying, and a vague **ଦେଖିବା** ('we'll see') or **ସବୁ ସେମିତି ଚାଲିଛି** is a perfectly good answer. Among friends, catching up means an **ଆଡ୍ଡା**: tea, ଗୁପଚୁପ or ଚାଟ୍ and hours of talk. Tell news with the perfect (ମୁଁ ଜ୍ୱାଇନ୍ କରିଛି, ସେ ବାହାହୋଇଛି) and expect the mock-offended **ମୋତେ କାହିଁକି କହିଲ ନାହିଁ?** if you kept something quiet. Places people swap stories about: **Chilika** lake (dolphins, migratory birds), **Daringbadi** ('the Kashmir of Odisha'), **Konark**, and of course Puri's Rath Yatra.

tip.title: Catching-up openers
tip.body:
- Open with **ବହୁତ ଦିନ ପରେ ଦେଖା!** or **ଆଉ, କ'ଣ ଖବର?**
- The answer is rarely just 'fine': **ସବୁ ସେମିତି ଚାଲିଛି** 'same old', **କିଛି ବିଶେଷ ନୁହେଁ** 'nothing much'.
- **ବିତିବା** 'to pass (time)' asks how something went: ୱିକେଣ୍ଡ୍ କେମିତି **ବିତିଲା**?

sentences.native: ଆଜିକାଲି ତୁମେ କ'ଣ କରୁଛ?
sentences.roman: ajikali tume kôṇô kôruchhô?
sentences.en: What are you up to these days?

sentences.native: ଆଜିକାଲି ଅଫିସରେ ବହୁତ କାମ।
sentences.roman: ajikali ôphisre bôhutô kamô.
sentences.en: Loads of work at the office these days.

sentences.native: ଛୁଟି ବହୁତ ମଜାରେ ବିତିଲା।
sentences.roman: chhuṭi bôhutô môjare bitila.
sentences.en: The holiday was great fun.

sentences.native: ରବିବାର ଘରେ ବସି ବସି ବୋର୍ ହୋଇଗଲି।
sentences.roman: rôbibarô ghôre bôsi bôsi bor hoigôli.
sentences.en: I got bored sitting around at home on Sunday.

sentences.native: ତୁମ ଜୀବନରେ ନୂଆ କ'ଣ ଅଛି?
sentences.roman: tumô jibônôre nua kôṇô ôchhi?
sentences.en: What's new in your life?

sentences.native: ସିନେମାଟା ପୂରା ବୋର୍ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: sinemaṭa pura bor thila.
sentences.en: The film was totally boring.

sentences.native: ଏ ସପ୍ତାହରେ କିଛି ବିଶେଷ ହେଲା ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: e sôptahôre kichhi bisesô hela nahiṃ.
sentences.en: Nothing special happened this week.

sentences.native: ଘରେ ସମସ୍ତେ ଭଲ ଅଛନ୍ତି ତ?
sentences.roman: ghôre sômôste bhôlô ôchhônti tô?
sentences.en: Everyone at home is well, I hope?

tip.title: Have you ever…? -ଇଛ କି?
tip.body:
- Ask with **କେବେ** + the perfect + **କି**: କେବେ କୋଣାର୍କ **ଯାଇଛ କି**?
- Yes: ହଁ, ଥରେ / ତିନି ଥର **ଯାଇଛି**. Never: **କେବେ ବି** + **-ଇନି**: କେବେ ବି ଯାଇନି.
- Add a finished time and switch to the past: ଗତ ମାସରେ **ଗଲୁ**; long ago: ପିଲାଦିନେ **ଦେଖିଥିଲୁ**.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ କେବେ କୋଣାର୍କ ଯାଇଛ କି?
sentences.roman: tume kebe Koṇarkô jaichhô ki?
sentences.en: Have you ever been to Konark?

sentences.native: ହଁ, ତିନି ଥର ଯାଇଛି।
sentences.roman: hôṃ, tini thôrô jaichhi.
sentences.en: Yes, I've been three times.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ କେବେ ବି ପଖାଳ ଖାଇନି।
sentences.roman: muṃ kebe bi pôkhaḷô khaini.
sentences.en: I've never had pakhala.

sentences.native: ଗତ ମାସରେ ଆମେ ଦାରିଙ୍ଗବାଡ଼ି ଟ୍ରିପ୍ ଗଲୁ।
sentences.roman: gôtô masôre ame Dariṅgbaṛi ṭrip gôlu.
sentences.en: Last month we went on a trip to Daringbadi.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ସେ ନୂଆ ସିନେମା ଦେଖିଛ କି?
sentences.roman: tume se nua sinema dekhichhô ki?
sentences.en: Have you seen that new film?

sentences.native: ନା, ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଦେଖିନି, ଏହି ଶନିବାର ଦେଖିବି।
sentences.roman: na, epôrjyôntô dekhini, ehi sônibarô dekhibi.
sentences.en: No, not yet — I'll see it this Saturday.

sentences.native: ଆମେ ପିଲାଦିନେ ଥରେ ପୁରୀରେ ରଥଯାତ୍ରା ଦେଖିଥିଲୁ।
sentences.roman: ame piladine thôre Purire Rôthôjatra dekhithilu.
sentences.en: As kids we once saw the Rath Yatra in Puri.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ଛୁଟି କେଉଁଠି କଟାଇଲ?
sentences.roman: tume chhuṭi keuṃṭhi kôṭailô?
sentences.en: Where did you spend your holidays?

sentences.native: ସେ ଟ୍ରିପ୍ ମୋ ଜୀବନର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ଅନୁଭବ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: se ṭrip mo jibônôrô sôbuṭharu bhôlô ônubhôbô thila.
sentences.en: That trip was the best experience of my life.

tip.title: News: the perfect -ଇଛି
tip.body:
- Give news with the perfect: ମୁଁ ଜ୍ୱାଇନ୍ **କରିଛି**, ସେ ପାସ୍ **କରିଛି**, ଭାଇନା **ଫେରିଛନ୍ତି**.
- Changes take ଯିବା: ସହର **ବଦଳିଯାଇଛି**.
- When someone asks **କେବେ?**, answer in the simple past: ଗତ ମାସରେ ଜ୍ୱାଇନ୍ **କଲି**.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଏବେ ଏବେ ମୋ କୋର୍ସ୍ ସାରିଛି।
sentences.roman: muṃ ebe ebe mo kôrs sarichhi.
sentences.en: I've just finished my course.

sentences.native: ମୋ ସାନ ଭାଇ ପରୀକ୍ଷାରେ ପାସ୍ କରିଛି!
sentences.roman: mo sanô bhai pôrikhyare pas kôrichhi!
sentences.en: My little brother has passed his exams!

sentences.native: ସେ ଗତ ମାସରେ ନୂଆ ଚାକିରି ଜ୍ୱାଇନ୍ କଲା।
sentences.roman: se gôtô masôre nua chakiri jwain kôla.
sentences.en: She joined a new job last month.

sentences.native: ଆରେ, ଏ ସହର ବହୁତ ବଦଳିଯାଇଛି!
sentences.roman: are, e sôhôrô bôhutô bôdôḷijaichhi!
sentences.en: Wow, this city has changed a lot!

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଗତ ବର୍ଷ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରୀକ୍ଷାରେ ଫେଲ୍ ହୋଇଥିଲି।
sentences.roman: muṃ gôtô bôrsô goṭie pôrikhyare phel hoithili.
sentences.en: I failed one exam last year.

sentences.native: ତୁମ ବାହାଘର କେବେ ଠିକ୍ ହେଲା?
sentences.roman: tumô bahaghôrô kebe ṭhik hela?
sentences.en: When did your wedding get fixed?

sentences.native: ଭାଇନା ଏବେ ଏବେ ଆମେରିକାରୁ ଫେରିଛନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: bhaina ebe ebe Amerikaru pherichhônti.
sentences.en: My big brother has just come back from America.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଖାଇବା ସାରିନି।
sentences.roman: muṃ epôrjyôntô khaiba sarini.
sentences.en: I haven't finished eating yet.

tip.title: Was doing: -ଉଥିଲି
tip.body:
- Scene: **-ଉଥିଲି** 'was doing'; the interruption: **-ଇଲି**: ମୁଁ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳା**ଉଥିଲି**, ସେତେବେଳେ ଫୋନ ଆସି**ଲା**.
- Link with **ଯେତେବେଳେ** … 'when …'.
- States take **-ଇଥିଲି**: ମୁଁ **ଶୋଇଥିଲି** 'I was asleep', ସେ ବସିଥିଲା 'he was sitting'.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ଫୋନ କଲ, ମୁଁ ସେତେବେଳେ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଉଥିଲି।
sentences.roman: tume phonô kôlô, muṃ setebeḷe gaṛi chôḷauthili.
sentences.en: When you called, I was driving.

sentences.native: ଯେତେବେଳେ ଏ ଘଟଣା ଘଟିଲା, ତୁମେ କେଉଁଠି ଥିଲ?
sentences.roman: jetebeḷe e ghôṭôṇa ghôṭila, tume keuṃṭhi thilô?
sentences.en: Where were you when this happened?

sentences.native: ଆମେ ହଷ୍ଟେଲରେ ରାତି ଦୁଇଟା ଯାଏ ଗପ କରୁଥିଲୁ।
sentences.roman: ame hôsṭelre rati duiṭa jae gôpô kôruthilu.
sentences.en: In the hostel we used to chat till two in the morning.

sentences.native: ପଢ଼ା ଭଲରେ ଚାଲୁଥିଲା, ହଠାତ୍ ବାପାଙ୍କ ଦେହ ଖରାପ ହେଲା।
sentences.roman: pôṛha bhôlôre chaluthila, hôṭhat bapaṅkô dehô khôrapô hela.
sentences.en: My studies were going well, then suddenly Dad fell ill.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ କାଲି ରାତିରେ କ'ଣ କରୁଥିଲ?
sentences.roman: tume kali ratire kôṇô kôruthilô?
sentences.en: What were you doing last night?

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଶୋଇଥିଲି, ସେଥିପାଇଁ ଫୋନ ଶୁଣିପାରିଲି ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: muṃ soithili, sethipaiṃ phonô suṇiparili nahiṃ.
sentences.en: I was asleep, so I didn't hear the phone.

sentences.native: କ'ଣ ଘଟିଲା? ତୁମେ ଏତେ ଚିନ୍ତାରେ କାହିଁକି?
sentences.roman: kôṇô ghôṭila? tume ete chintare kahiṃki?
sentences.en: What happened? Why are you so worried?

sentences.native: ଆମେ ପୁରୀ ଯାଉଥିଲୁ, ବାଟରେ ଗାଡ଼ି ଖରାପ ହୋଇଗଲା।
sentences.roman: ame Puri jauthilu, baṭôre gaṛi khôrapô hoigôla.
sentences.en: We were on our way to Puri when the car broke down.

lessons.title: How long? Since when?

tip.title: Ago, since, for
tip.body:
- Ago: time + **ତଳେ** — ଦଶ ବର୍ଷ ତଳେ.
- Since: **-ରୁ / -ଠାରୁ**, **ସେତେବେଳୁ**, after an event **ପରଠୁ**; ask **କେବେଠୁ?**
- For (still going): time + **ହେଲା** + present: ଦୁଇ ମାସ ହେଲା ଜିମ୍ ଯାଉଛି; or time + **ଧରି**.

new: ମୁଁ ଦୁଇ ମାସ ହେଲା ଜିମ୍ ଯାଉଛି।
ମୁଁ ଅଧ ଘଣ୍ଟା ଧରି ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରୁଛି!

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ତିନି ମାସ ହେଲା ଜିମ୍ ଯାଉଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଓଜନ କମୁନି!
sentences.roman: muṃ tini masô hela jim jauchhi, kintu ôjônô kômuni!
sentences.en: I've been going to the gym for three months, but my weight isn't going down!

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଦଶ ବର୍ଷ ତଳେ ଏ ସହରକୁ ଆସିଥିଲି।
sentences.roman: muṃ dôsô bôrsô tôḷe e sôhôrôku asithili.
sentences.en: I came to this city ten years ago.

sentences.native: ସେତେବେଳୁ ମୁଁ ଏଠି ରହୁଛି।
sentences.roman: setebeḷu muṃ eṭhi rôhuchhi.
sentences.en: I've lived here ever since.

sentences.native: ବାହାଘର ପରଠୁ ତା ଓଜନ ବହୁତ ବଢ଼ିଯାଇଛି।
sentences.roman: bahaghôrô pôrôṭhu ta ôjônô bôhutô bôṛhijaichhi.
sentences.en: He's put on a lot of weight since the wedding.

sentences.native: ଆମେ ଦୁଇ ଘଣ୍ଟା ଧରି ଟ୍ରାଫିକରେ ଫସିଛୁ।
sentences.roman: ame dui ghôṇṭa dhôri ṭraphikre phôsichhu.
sentences.en: We've been stuck in traffic for two hours.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ କେବେଠୁ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଶିଖୁଛ?
sentences.roman: tume kebeṭhu Oṛia sikhuchhô?
sentences.en: Since when have you been learning Odia?

sentences.native: ଗତ ବର୍ଷଠାରୁ ଅଟୋ ଭଡ଼ା ବହୁତ ବଢ଼ିଛି।
sentences.roman: gôtô bôrsôṭharu ôṭo bhôṛa bôhutô bôṛhichhi.
sentences.en: Auto fares have gone up a lot since last year.

sentences.native: ଅଧ ଘଣ୍ଟା ଧରି ମୁଁ ତୁମକୁ ଫୋନ କରୁଛି!
sentences.roman: ôdhô ghôṇṭa dhôri muṃ tumôku phonô kôruchhi!
sentences.en: I've been calling you for half an hour!

tip.title: Reacting to news
tip.body:
- Surprise: **ସତରେ?** 'really?', **ଏଇଟା କେବେ ହେଲା?** 'when did this happen?'
- Mock offence: **ମୋତେ କାହିଁକି କହିଲ ନାହିଁ?**
- Parting: **ଯୋଗାଯୋଗରେ ରହିବା** — the ଆମେ-future works as 'let's'.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ବାହାହେଲ, ଆଉ ମୋତେ ଡାକିଲ ନାହିଁ!
sentences.roman: tume bahahelô, au mote ḍakilô nahiṃ!
sentences.en: You got married and didn't invite me!

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ଡାକିଥିଲି, ତୁମ ନମ୍ବର ମୋ ପାଖରେ ନ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: muṃ sômôstôṅku ḍakithili, tumô nômbôrô mo pakhôre nô thila.
sentences.en: I invited everyone — I just didn't have your number.

sentences.native: ଏଥର ଠିକ୍ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗରେ ରହିବା।
sentences.roman: ethôrô ṭhik jogajogôre rôhiba.
sentences.en: This time let's really stay in touch.

sentences.native: ପୁରୁଣା ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କ ସହିତ ଆଉ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: puruṇa saṅgômanôṅkô sôhitô au jogajogô nahiṃ.
sentences.en: I'm not in touch with my old friends any more.

sentences.native: ସତରେ? ସେମାନଙ୍କର ବ୍ରେକଅପ୍ ହୋଇଗଲା?
sentences.roman: sôtôre? semanôṅkôrô brekôp hoigôla?
sentences.en: Really? They broke up?

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଭାବିଥିଲି ସେ ରାଗିବ, କିନ୍ତୁ ହେଲା ଓଲଟା।
sentences.roman: muṃ bhabithili se ragibô, kintu hela ôlôṭa.
sentences.en: I thought he would get angry, but it was the opposite.

sentences.native: ଆସନ୍ତା ମାସରେ ପୁଣି ଦେଖା ହେବ, ପକ୍କା?
sentences.roman: asônta masôre puṇi dekha hebô, pôkka?
sentences.en: We'll meet again next month — promise?

sentences.native: ତୁମ ନୂଆ ଚାକିରି କଥା ମୁଁ ଫେସବୁକରୁ ଜାଣିଲି!
sentences.roman: tumô nua chakiri kôtha muṃ Phesbukôru jaṇili!
sentences.en: I found out about your new job from Facebook!
